title: 初二长对话：公交卡与手偶
source_notice: 初二普通期末公开卷具体结构已核；主卷三节5/5/5与参考键合写后10题标题冲突保留。正文地域未知、学校原版未认证；首5脚本完整而后段截断，原录音缺，不当gold。本稿为完整原创配套，未通过独立教研/学生/商用或生产验证。
timing_notice: 每段两遍，听前听后每题5秒；间隔和重播提示为本机编排
instruction: 听两段长对话，第一段回答第1—2题，第二段回答第3—5题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍，听前、听后按每题5秒留时。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: You left your bus card on the kitchen table again, Leo. I found it after you went to school.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Thanks, Mum. I borrowed some money from Max for the bus home.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Put the card in the front pocket of your bag now, before you forget.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I will. Can I help with dinner first?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The rice is cooking. Please wash the carrots, and then you can get your bag.

questions.stem: What is the relationship between the speakers?
questions.rationale: A：厨房卡片与Mum不支持师生；B：明确称Mum；C：不是姐弟

questions.stem: What does the woman ask Leo to do before getting his bag?
questions.rationale: A：明确先洗胡萝卜；B：米已经在煮；C：借钱是已发生的事

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Are you free on Saturday, Jo? My cousin is showing us how to make shadow puppets at the arts room.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That sounds interesting. I thought they were made of wood.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Some are, but we will use thick paper. There will be scissors and sticks there.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: At two. We should arrive fifteen minutes early to choose a design.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: All right. I will bring my little brother. He loves making things.

questions.stem: Who will teach them to make puppets?
questions.rationale: A：弟弟是参与者；B：未提老师；C：明确my cousin

questions.stem: What will they use to make the puppets?
questions.rationale: A：女方原先猜想被纠正；B：明确we will use thick paper；C：未提布料
A：两点前15分钟是1:45；B：是开始时间；C：把提前算成推后
